name: apphaven
description: A home for web apps and websites ChatGPT builds: hosted, secured, and held to a standard.

interface.shortDescription: A home for websites and apps
interface.longDescription:
ChatGPT builds the web app or website. Apphaven gives it a home and makes it safe to hand to people.

Whether you’re building an interactive tool or a website for your business, it gets the same care. Your own name, your own address on the web, and a home you can keep improving. If it needs accounts, people sign up and sign in without fuss, and see only what they’re meant to. If it sends confirmations or notices, those emails look like they came from you.

What you experience is calm. Ask ChatGPT for a change and it works on a copy first, away from the people using your live app or website. You look it over and decide when it goes live. Changes that delete user data need your approval, and saved versions give you a way back if you take a wrong turn. Your console shows what’s happening: who signed up, what went out, and how busy it’s been.

You don’t need to write code or manage servers. You describe, you look, you decide.
